body:
this time i am really sad because i have also been kicked from bad company which i only just joined. please may i see evidence and all i want to say is that im really upset and i would never hack on any server, especially avicus :(

Edit: I have already been banned twice on avicus before this and have been warned that moderators will be keeping a close eye on me from now on. It would take some serious stupidity to use anti knock back hacks to run through a moderator that has banned me before and wants to do it again as he shoots and hits me. Not to mention I have just joined a really good competitive team. Why would I throw it all away? Although this is not proving anything by any means, it is worth mentioning in my appeal

replies.author: piratewithgun
replies.body:
Iron once wrote in response to a forum post that moderators need to be 100% sure before banning a competitive player for hacking. So I can only assume that Vobase is certain of "my hacks". However multiple moderators have said to me that they know I wasn't hacking, even after watching the evidence. And one Sr mod says it looks 50 50. I believe that the current system in the staff team is that you all talk about it and come to a conclusion about whether to appeal me or not depending on whether you can all agree on whether you are 100% that I am hacking or if there is uncertainty then you can't ban me. My suggestion is that you have your big discussion BEFORE you ban me to avoiding wasting everyones time. It is just my opinion but to me the constant ban appeal ban appeal ban appeal seems inefficient. 

Thank you for dealing with my appeal and please let me know of what you think about the small suggestion
